terms.comment: An ordinary description: trulla, the trowel (see trowel), with dentātus, toothed, which Varro has of rakes (LL 5.136, in Lewis & Short). No reference work names the notched trowel, the toothed kind used to comb adhesive into ridges; Morgan–Owens s.v. notched has serrātus and denticulātus.

sources: Lewis & Short: dentatus · Lewis & Short: trulla
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. notched.
